description.value: Richmond Country Farms is a family-owned working farm in Richmond, operating for over 60 years, where crops are grown on-site and sold directly in a seasonal farm market alongside baked goods and local products. The property also includes a winery with tastings, a lounge, and a picnic area, plus farm animals and a nursery, making it a genuinely multifaceted rural destination in an urban setting. Cyclists exploring the Steveston area will find it a distinctive stop combining fresh local produce with agricultural character.
